summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Analytics for Hospitality and Tourism Training Course. Learn to leverage data for better decision-making in the industry.
lede: Data Analytics for Hospitality and Tourism equips hospitality and tourism professionals to turn transactional data, spreadsheets, PMS exports, and guest reviews into actionable insight. Across a 10-day program, you build practical skills in descriptive statistics, multi-variable regression for demand forecasting, competitive set analysis, and sentiment analysis. You also learn to develop dynamic pricing models, audit digital marketing spend with GA4, connect CRM data to guest journeys, calculate GOPPAR and TRevPAR, automate reporting, and track sustainability. These capabilities support decisions on booking lead times, inventory across distribution channels, and operating performance in tight-margin, high-volume environments.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who manage assets, revenue, or guest experiences in the travel and lodging sectors.
modules: Visualizing Hospitality Data with Power BI®
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of hospitality operations or revenue management. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel (basic formulas and pivot tables) is required. Access to a laptop with Power BI® Desktop installed is recommended for the visualization modules.
